papers.title: Rationalizing Neural Predictions
papers.findings: Joint generator and selected-input encoder are trained against task targets with cardinality/continuity regularizers. No rationale annotation is not no task supervision. Actual task loss is against gold y, not explicit fixed-full-model distillation.
papers.limits: Selected methods/theorem scope; no complete experiment/source audit or replication. Supplement matched via official article link. No human-reading attestation.

papers.title: Learning to Explain: An Information-Theoretic Perspective on Model Interpretation
papers.findings: Fixed model-response distribution defines the information objective. Selected-feature conditional, auxiliary variational decoder and original model run on masked raw input are distinct. Equality/family/optimization and at-most-k sampling versus deterministic top-k retained.
